product.name: Regular Fit Sports Shirt in DryMove™
product.description: Regular-fit sports shirt in DryMove™ functional fabric to wick away moisture from skin and keep you comfortably dry while moving. Round neck, printed motif on chest and at back, and short sleeves. Straight-cut hem, slightly longer at back. Slit at sides.
